prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is approached, take it. If it's heavy then move to destination. Scan, approach or do subtask.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = isObjectHeavy    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = DoSubtask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF isObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDestination
	END
